Вязкость топливного масла

The measure of a fuel oil’s resistance to flow, critical for engine injection and atomization; monitored and regulated in shipboard fuel systems.

Definition

The measure of a fuel oil’s resistance to flow, critical for engine injection and atomization; monitored and regulated in shipboard fuel systems.

Operational example
